evidence.out: 68:  lineage_mode: "[auto|resume|restart|completed-continue] - Session lifecycle intent. Default: auto. `resume` keeps the same sessionId and archives nothing. `restart` opens a new sessionId at generation+1 and archives the prior research/ packet. `completed-continue` comes from --extend=N and extends a completed run in place by N iterations, same sessionId and generation."

critic_override.note: The flag takes three values by design; `completed-continue` is derived from `--extend=N`, not passed to `--lineage-mode`. The command's own presentation contract says so: deep-research-presentation.txt:75 'flag `--lineage-mode=auto|resume|restart`', :117 '`--lineage-mode=auto|resume|restart -> lineage_mode = value`', :207 'lineage_mode = [auto/resume/restart from flag, marker, or default auto; completed-continue from --extend=N]'. Passing `--lineage-mode=completed-continue` without `--extend` reaches step_extend_completed_run and fails with '--extend needs a positive integer' (deep-research.yaml:488). The workflow input enum lists the fourth value because the workflow binds it from `--extend`, not because the flag accepts it.
